resources.string: Save network names and passwords in your encrypted snapshot
Confirm your phone PIN, pattern or password to set a new Vault password
Confirm your phone lock to reset the Vault encryption password.
Unlock HeckerVault. Backup and restore will not ask again during this visit.
Set a phone PIN, pattern or password in Settings before resetting Vault encryption.
Choose one password for your backups. This phone remembers it securely, so backup and restore need no further password. Keep it separately to restore after a clean flash.
New snapshots will use the new password. This phone keeps previous passwords to open earlier snapshots. After wiping the phone, each older snapshot still needs its original password.
Could not unlock or save the Vault key. Unlock the phone and try again.
This snapshot uses a password this phone does not remember, or the file is damaged. Enter its original password once. Vault will remember it only after the whole archive is verified.
